title: 第63章 给我们也买一台
content_zh:
第63章 给我们也买一台-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

赵志军愣了一下，缩了缩脖子，没再说什么，端着盘子去给客人上菜了。

赵素梅今天没来店里，在家养胎。

林国强收工后骑着自行车往家走，路过老宅的时候，远远地看见老宅的灯还亮着。

李红霞的哭嚎声隐隐约约地从院子里传出来。

他没有停下来。

他把自行车蹬快了几步，从老宅门口过去了。

回到家，赵素梅已经把饭做好了。

虽然林国强不让她干重活，但她还是闲不住，总要做饭、洗衣、收拾屋子。

林国强说过她几次，她嘴上答应，转头又去干了。

林国强没办法，只能尽量早点回来帮忙。

“回来了？吃饭吧。”赵素梅把菜端上桌。

林国强洗了手，在桌边坐下，端起碗吃了一口饭。

“国强，”赵素梅犹豫了一下，问，“老宅那边的事，你听说了吗？”

“听说了。”

“你不回去看看？”

“看什么？”林国强夹了一口菜，“她们闹她们的，我过我的。

我又不是村长，管不了那么多。”

赵素梅看着他，心里微微松了一口气。

她发现林国强现在对老宅的事越来越冷淡了。

以前家里有什么事，他总是第一个到，第一个出头，第一个帮忙。

现在呢？他连问都懒得问了。

不是冷血，是寒心了。

分家的时候被排挤，年夜饭被排除在外，林美丽出嫁的时候被当成外人。

一次一次地，他的心被这些人磨凉了。

现在他只想守着自己的小家过日子。

“吃饭吧。”林国强给她夹了一块肉。

赵素梅点了点头，低下头吃饭，不再问了。

林静在院子里跑来跑去。

林薇坐在垫子上，抱着布偶小兔子、拨浪鼓玩。

灶台上的炉火还燃着，锅里的汤还在冒着热气。

这一屋子的安宁，跟老宅那边的吵闹形成了鲜明的对比。

林国强吃完饭，把碗筷收了，去灶台边刷碗。

赵素梅坐在炕沿上，给林静讲睡前故事。

林薇已经睡着了，小嘴微微张着，呼吸均匀。

水龙头哗哗地响着，碗碟碰撞发出清脆的声音。

林国强低着头刷碗，脑子里却在想事情。

Zhao Zhijun was stunned for a moment, shrank his neck, said nothing, and went to serve the guests with the plate.

Zhao Sumei did not come to the store today and was raising her baby at home.

Lin Guoqiang rode his bicycle home after finishing work. When he passed by the old house, he saw the lights of the old house were still on in the distance.

Li Hongxia's cries could be heard faintly from the yard.

He didn't stop.

He pedaled his bicycle a few steps faster and passed by the door of the old house.

When she got home, Zhao Sumei had already prepared the meal.

Although Lin Guoqiang didn't let her do heavy work, she still couldn't sit idle and always had to cook, wash and clean the house.

Lin Guoqiang told her several times, and she agreed, then turned around and went back to work.

Lin Guoqiang had no choice but to come back as soon as possible to help.

"You're back? Let's eat." Zhao Sumei put the dishes on the table.

Lin Guoqiang washed his hands, sat down at the table, picked up the bowl and took a bite of rice.

"Guoqiang," Zhao Sumei hesitated and asked, "Have you heard about what happened at the old house?"

"I heard about it."

"Don't you go back and take a look?"

"What are you looking at?" Lin Guoqiang took a mouthful of food, "They are making trouble, and I will make mine.

I'm not the village chief, so I can't control that much."

Zhao Sumei looked at him and felt slightly relieved.

She found that Lin Guoqiang was becoming more and more indifferent to matters in his old house.

In the past, when something happened at home, he was always the first to arrive, the first to step forward, and the first to help.

What now?He didn't even bother to ask.

It's not cold-blooded, it's cold-hearted.

When the family was separated, she was excluded, excluded from the New Year's Eve dinner, and when Lin Meili got married, she was treated as an outsider.

Time and time again, his heart was chilled by these people.

Now he just wants to live in his own little home.

"Let's eat." Lin Guoqiang gave her a piece of meat.

Zhao Sumei nodded, lowered her head to eat, and asked no more questions.

Lin Jing was running around in the yard.

Lin Wei sat on the mat, holding a stuffed rabbit and playing with a rattle.

The fire on the stove was still burning, and the soup in the pot was still steaming.

The tranquility of this room was in sharp contrast to the noise in the old house.

After Lin Guoqiang finished eating, he put away the bowls and chopsticks and went to the stove to wash the dishes.

Zhao Sumei sat on the edge of the Kang and told Lin Jing a bedtime story.

Lin Wei was already asleep, with her mouth slightly open and breathing evenly.

The faucet buzzed, and the dishes clattered against each other.

Lin Guoqiang lowered his head to wash the dishes, but he was thinking about something.
